text: Chile, 2010. A mine collapsed. *33 men were trapped* about 700 meters underground. For 17 days, nobody knew if they were alive. Then a drill came up with a note: "We are fine in the shelter, the 33." On day 69, the first man rose up in a tiny capsule. Florencio Ávalos. *His 7-year-old son was waiting.* The boy couldn't stop crying. Send this to your dad.
title: 69 Days Underground. Then He Saw His Son. ⛏️❤️
